categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Touches CMakeLists.txt and Guix build scripts with the 'Build system' label.
categories.rationale: Silences Apple linker warnings about duplicate libraries and aligns macOS Guix builds with other targets by treating linker warnings as fatal errors. This provides worthwhile build hygiene and helps catch real linker issues earlier on macOS, but does not fix broken builds or critical release reproducibility failures.

categories.name: tools
categories.evidence: The category explicitly excludes build and release scripts, which belong to build.
categories.rationale: The modified scripts under contrib/guix/libexec/ are Guix build scripts and belong to the build category rather than tools.
